logical_fallacies.example: A politician discredits an opponent by criticizing their character instead of addressing the policy.
logical_fallacies.occurrence: Rep. Matt Gaetz questioning Hunter Biden about being on drugs while on the Burisma board instead of focusing on the relevant topic of the impeachment inquiry into Biden's father.

logical_fallacies.example: Dismissing someone's opinion on economic policy because they belong to a different political party.
logical_fallacies.occurrence: Rep. Matt Gaetz questioning Hunter Biden's drug use while serving on the Burisma board, which is unrelated to the impeachment inquiry or oversight of ethics legislation.

logical_fallacies.example: Shifting the debate on climate change to economic costs without addressing environmental impacts.
logical_fallacies.occurrence: Rep. Matt Gaetz focusing on questioning Hunter Biden's drug use instead of addressing the core issues related to the impeachment inquiry concerning Biden's father.
